name: archery-app
description: Repo-level tooling. The mobile and backend packages keep their own dependencies; only linting, formatting and the scripts that run across both live here.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix mobile test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
